label: Diagram 2.2
caption: Diagram 2.2 | Measurement of clear opening width and other features of external and internal doors | Other communal doors
description: The drawing is a plan view of a door set in a wall, with the door leaf shown swung open by a curved line that traces its arc from the closed position, a horizontal line across the opening at the bottom, to an open position lying flat against the left‑hand wall as a vertical line. The free (top) end of the open leaf is marked at the top left by two short projecting lines labelled c (leading edge) and d (following edge). Label a points to the inside face of the door when open on the left‑hand wall; label b points to the inside edge of the door frame or stop on the lower side of the opening. A horizontal double‑headed arrow runs between a and b along the bottom, captioned "distance a‑b = clear opening width". On the right wall, a small dimension e spans the nib to the leading edge, and f marks the reveal depth at the opening. To the right of the plan, a Key lists letters a to f with their definitions, including "300mm min" for e and "200mm max to door face when closed" for f, followed by two Notes and the line "*all dimensions are minimum except where noted". A green band at the bottom reads "Diagram 2.2 Measurement of clear opening width and other features of external and internal doors".
